stateful_dataset_exemption.reason: The inherited Jenkins home is a deterministic multi-file operational state graph generated through /app/plugin/bin/insights rather than a relational SQL corpus. The real generator creates 10,000-20,000 varied jobs, builds, queue items, nodes, fingerprints, plugins, and malformed records; committing an additional SQL shadow dataset would be decorative and would not participate in plugin reconciliation. The verifier exercises a 10,000-record generation and the environment image creates the default 14,536-record home through the production entrypoint.

domain_state_model: nested Jenkins jobs and build histories
queue demand and node executor capacity
installed, disabled, failed, bundled, and dependency plugin metadata
checksummed event journal and immutable generation catalog
authorization anchors, retained tombstones, source errors, and capability state
production_authenticity.reachability_evidence: All generated state is created, reconciled, queried, replayed, recovered, migrated, and compacted through /app/plugin/bin/insights and the same production Java core used by Jenkins lifecycle bindings.
